defs.def: the part or side of sth that faces forward; the side of sth that you look at first 正面

ex.s: The clear front of the box had a “keyhole” in a geometric shape, and the birds were given five differently shaped “keys” to choose from.
ex.t: 盒子透明的正面有一个几何形状的“钥匙孔”，鸟儿们会得到五个形状各异的“钥匙”供选择。

ex.s: If a strange family showed up on her front doorstep, Mom would have been delighted.
ex.t: 如果有一户陌生人家出现在她家门口，妈妈本会很高兴的。

ex.s: How many kinds of wildflowers can be seen from your front door If your awareness is as sharp as it could be, you'll have no trouble answering these questions．
ex.t: 从前门口能看到多少种野花？如果你的感知力足够敏锐，回答这些问题不在话下。

ex.s: There's one notable gap in my new-media experience, however: I've spent little time in front of a camera, since I have a face made for radio.
ex.t: 然而，我在新媒体经验中有一个明显的空白：我很少出现在镜头前，因为我有一张适合做广播的脸。

ex.s: Before we start, please come to the front one by one and introduce yourself to the class.
ex.t: 在我们开始之前，请一个接一个地来到前面，向全班介绍自己。

defs.def: the position that is in the direction that sb/sth is facing 前面；正前方
the part of sth that is furthest forward 前部
the part of sb's body that faces forwards; sb's chest 身体前部；胸部
the side of a large building, especially a church, that faces west, north, etc. （建筑物，尤指教堂朝西、北、东、南等的）面

ex.s: Their lower front teeth were not large enough.
ex.t: 他们的下门牙不够大。

ex.s: Mrs Hill’s front window faced Mr and Mrs Green’s house across the street.
ex.t: 希尔太太家的前窗正对着街对面格林夫妇的房子。

ex.s: You may use both the front and back of the paper.
ex.t: 你可以使用纸的正反两面。

defs.def: the road or area of land along the edge of the sea, a lake or a river 海滨；湖畔；河边；沿海（或湖、河）道路
an area where fighting takes place during a war 前线；前方

ex.s: By underinflating the front bags, the team allowed the platform carrying the tree to roll up the ramp and out of the hole while staying level, A trailer hauled the tree along as team members removed the airbags from the back of the platform and replaced them in the front.
ex.t: 通过给前袋少充气，团队让载树的平台在保持水平的情况下滚上坡道出坑，拖车拖着树前行，成员们从平台后方取下气囊补到前方。

defs.def: a particular area of activity 活动领域；阵线
behaviour that is not genuine, done in order to hide your true feelings or opinions 表面；外表
a person or an organization that is used to hide an illegal or secret activity 非法（或秘密）活动掩护者
（用于政治组织的名称）阵线
the line where a mass of cold air meets a mass of warm air （冷暖空气团接触的）锋
in a position that is further forward than sb/sth but not very far away 在前面

ex.s: Captain Nemo walked in front, one of his men following some steps behind.
ex.t: 尼摩船长走在前面，他的一名手下跟在后面几步远的地方。

ex.s: Mary’s sister, Frances Todd Wallace, often came over   63   （plant）flowers in the front yard.
ex.t: 玛丽的妹妹弗朗西斯·托德·华莱士经常过来在前院   63   （种/plant）花。

defs.def: in first place in a race or competition （赛跑或比赛）领先
in a position that is further forward than sb/sth but not very far away 在 … 前面

ex.s: A table and two chairs at front centre.
ex.t: 一张桌子和两把椅子在正中靠前。

ex.s: “People from cultures that value relationships more than ours does are shocked by the thought of eating alone in front of a computer”, says Art Markman, a professor of psychology at the University of Texas, Austin.
ex.t: "来自比我们更重视人际关系的文化背景的人会对在电脑前独自吃饭的想法感到震惊，"德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校心理学教授Art Markman说。

ex.s: He pulled in front of it as the wolf was catching up fast, just a dozen yards away now.
ex.t: 他冲到那辆车前面，这时狼正在快速逼近，只有十几码远了。

defs.def: if you do sth in front of sb, you do it when they are there 当着 … 的面；在 … 面前

ex.s: Once in a lecture, the professor tried repeating my name after me over and over in front of thirty classmates.
ex.t: 有一次在课上，教授当着三十名同学的面，一遍又一遍地跟着我重复我的名字。

ex.s: Meet in front of the Visitor Education Center.
ex.t: 在游客教育中心前集合。

ex.s: Picture this: my grandson sitting on my lap as I hold the book in front so he can see the pictures.
ex.t: 想象一下：我的孙子坐在我腿上，我把书举在他面前让他看到图片。

ex.s: In front of me was an array of foods I couldn’t even name in my native language.
ex.t: 摆在我面前的是一系列我用母语都叫不出名字的食物。

ex.s: You have to be at least a bit self-assured to laugh at yourself in front of others.
ex.t: 你至少要有一点自信，才能在别人面前自嘲。

ex.s: It didn’t take long before they walked through the front door carrying a big box.
ex.t: Poppy像往常一样欢迎他们回家，但当她看到盒子时，停了下来。

ex.s: Suddenly football feel just in front of me but almost hit me.
ex.t: 突然一个足球掉在我面前，差点砸到我。

ex.s: I was afraid that to speak in front of a larger group of people.
ex.t: 我害怕在更多人面前讲话。

ex.s: （1分）It was only when the car pulled up in front of our house               we saw Lily in the passenger seat．（  ）
ex.t: 14．（1分）只有当汽车停在我们家门前时，____我们才看到副驾驶座上的莉莉。（  ）

ex.s: After spotting a   18    on the front seat inside a parked car with its window down, he stood guard in the rain for about two hours waiting for the    19    to return.
ex.t: 看到一辆停着的车车窗摇下、前座上有个___18___后，他在雨中守了约两小时，等___19___回来。

ex.s: The car abruptly stopped in front of him
ex.t: 车子突然在他面前停了下来。

ex.s: The bus    45    a lamp post and it broke the glass on the front door before Harvold    46    to bring the bus to a stop.
ex.t: 公交车____45____一根灯柱，在Harvold____46____将公交车停下之前，它撞碎了前门的玻璃。

ex.s: If you are close to the front of the list, you have a good chance of gaining a place in the programme in the near future.
ex.t: 如果你排在名单靠前位置，你很有机会在近期获得该项目的一个名额。

ex.s: During the English class Meng Hao was nervous about introducing himself in front of the class.
ex.t: 英语课上，孟浩在全班面前做自我介绍时很紧张。

ex.s: It was amazing to be standing in front of her at last!
ex.t: 终于站在她面前了，这太神奇了！

ex.s: Eating alone, especially in front of the TV or computer, often leads to mindless overeating.
ex.t: 独自进食，尤其是在电视或电脑前，往往导致无意识的暴饮暴食。

defs.def: still to come; not yet passed 时间

ex.s: They stay in front of screens for too long.
ex.t: 他们在屏幕前待的时间太长了。

defs.def: in the part of a theatre, restaurant, etc. where the public sits （剧院等）观众席；（餐厅等）座席
in the area near to the entrance to a building 在（建筑物）大门外

ex.s: Kevin stared at the man at their front door.
ex.t: Kevin盯着他们前门外的那个男人。

ex.s: They share a front door and a washing machine, but Rita Whitehead has her own kitchen, bathroom, bedroom and living room on the ground floor.
ex.t: 他们共用一扇大门和一台洗衣机，但丽塔·怀特黑德在一楼有自己独立的厨房、浴室、卧室和起居室。

ex.s: The authors of Movement have it right: it’s time to think differently about that street outside your front door.
ex.t: 《运动》一书的作者说得对：是时候用不同的眼光看待你家前门外的那条街了。

defs.def: as payment in advance 预付；先付
in a forward position 体育运动
on or at the front of sth 前面的；前部的；在前的；正面的
produced with the front of the tongue in a higher position than the back, for example /iː/ in English 元音
to face sth or be in front of sth; to have the front pointing towards sth 面向；在 … 前面；朝；向
to have the front covered with sth 用 … 作正面；用 … 覆盖正面
to lead or represent an organization, a group, etc. 领导，代表（团体、组织等）
to present a television programme, a show, etc. 主持（电视节目、演出等）
to give more importance to a part of a sentence by placing it at or near the beginning of the sentence, as in ‘That I would like to see.’ （为强调而将句子某一部分）前置
